cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use black lettering on these moving labels. Pale blue may look pleasant, but it won't be legible from the van.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't packed any of the boxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A box without a clear destination is only a container. Write 'kitchen' in capitals, please, and leave room for the contents.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The van is outside. They want to start loading.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then face every label toward the door. No, all the same way. I won't have them blaming our organisation because they can't read an empty box.

reason: Make expert legibility and orientation the minor-detail refuge when B demands the actual packing; the arrival of loaders causes a new presentation correction.
